subject: english
stem: Which description matches the class-seat shares?
options: Dance had half of all seats, the largest share.
Cooking had half of all seats.
English had a larger share than Dance.

optionRationales.reason: All classes had equal shares.：三比例不同。
Dance had half of all seats, the largest share.：Dance 是 50%，也是最高。
Cooking had half of all seats.：Cooking 是 20%。
English had a larger share than Dance.：30% 低於 50%。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「英文句中的主詞、比較方向、數值與範圍全部對應圖表」可推出 Dance had half of all seats, the largest share.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Dance had half of all seats, the largest share. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
